title: The Unofficial Tryouts
author: L. M. Nakamura
blurb: Orsen Nystrom, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
